title: Red panda eating a snack
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M22,72 Q10,65 15,50 Q18,42 26,45 Q20,55 28,62 Q32,66 30,72 Z' fill='#c44a1c'/>
  <path d='M21,68 Q15,62 18,54 Q20,50 24,52 Q21,58 25,62 Z' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='24' ry='17' fill='#d4581e'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#e8a06a'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='87' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='87' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='44' r='22' fill='#d4581e'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <path d='M31,31 Q27,18 37,24 Z' fill='#d4581e'/>
  <path d='M69,31 Q73,18 63,24 Z' fill='#d4581e'/>
  <path d='M33,30 Q31,23 36,26 Z' fill='#e8a06a'/>
  <path d='M67,30 Q69,23 64,26 Z' fill='#e8a06a'/>
  <!-- Face mask -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#f5d6b8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#f5d6b8'/>
  <!-- Eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='42' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='42' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='42' r='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='42' r='3' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='41' r='1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='3.5' ry='2.5' fill='#1a1a2e'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50,52 Q46,56 43,53' fill='none' stroke='#8a2e10' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50,52 Q54,56 57,53' fill='none' stroke='#8a2e10' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Paws holding snack -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='61' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='61' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#8a2e10'/>
  <!-- Snack (bamboo / biscuit) -->
  <rect x='44' y='57' width='12' height='7' rx='2' fill='#7ccf4a'/>
  <rect x='44' y='57' width='12' height='2.5' rx='1' fill='#a8e87a'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#f09090' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='52' r='2.5' fill='#f09090' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
